design: 2x2: plain vs structured process, capability-only vs discriminating evidence
fixed: same goals, action sets, constraints, output fields and 600-word response limit
measurement: Appropriate action relative to supplied evidence; actionability separately from correctness; output word count only as artifact burden proxy.
limits: One output per cell, four authored cases; no replication or statistical claim.
Prompt process instructions necessarily differ between structure arms.
Capability-only appropriate deferral is correct, not a failure.
Cases are stipulated and not production observations.

cases.goal: Reduce delay while preserving accountable approval.
cases.capability_description: The team has an automatic summary generator and can request qualified decision delegation.
constraints: Do not assert a causal bottleneck without discriminating evidence.
causal_observations: Summaries are ready before the approval queue begins.
Only one approver has authority and qualified backups currently lack delegated rights.

cases.goal: Reduce delay while preserving accountable approval.
cases.capability_description: The team has an automatic summary generator and can request qualified decision delegation.
constraints: Do not assert a causal bottleneck without discriminating evidence.
causal_observations: Qualified approvers are idle awaiting summaries.
Summary preparation is measured as the sole accumulating queue.

cases.goal: Make a structured decision handoff carry the complete human requirement.
cases.capability_description: The team has a validator and a local schema editor.
constraints: Do not claim complete requirement coverage without comparing human requirements to represented fields.
causal_observations: Human requirements are decision, reason, and owner.
Schema and validator currently include only decision and reason.

cases.goal: Choose a cause-targeting next action without inventing causal evidence.
cases.capability_description: The team has summary generation and decision routing tools.
constraints: Different causes require different interventions; retain uncertainty if the given observation cannot distinguish them.
causal_observations: End-to-end delay increased, but summary and decision stage waits were not separately recorded.
